name: Cable Stability Ball Single-Arm Chest Press
steps: Rest your head and upper back on a stability ball beside a low pulley with its handle at your chest.
Plant both feet wide, lift your hips level, and press the handle straight above your chest.
Bend your working elbow under control to lower the handle back beside your chest.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your opposite shoulder level against the ball.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core to prevent your torso from twisting or rolling.
